import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.multiclass import OneVsRestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from scipy.sparse import hstack
import os

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Define target columns
target_cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]

# Split training data into train and validation sets (80/20)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    train_df["comment_text"],
    train_df[target_cols],
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=train_df["toxic"],  # Stratify on main toxic label
)

# Create word-level TF-IDF vectorizer
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="word",
    token_pattern=r"\w{1,}",
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    max_features=50000,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    strip_accents="unicode",
    lowercase=True,
)

# Create character-level TF-IDF vectorizer
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char",
    ngram_range=(3, 6),
    max_features=50000,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    strip_accents="unicode",
    lowercase=True,
)

# Fit and transform training data
X_train_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train)
X_train_char = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train)

# Combine word and character features
X_train_combined = hstack([X_train_word, X_train_char])

# Transform validation data
X_val_word = word_vectorizer.transform(X_val)
X_val_char = char_vectorizer.transform(X_val)
X_val_combined = hstack([X_val_word, X_val_char])

# Transform test data
X_test_word = word_vectorizer.transform(test_df["comment_text"])
X_test_char = char_vectorizer.transform(test_df["comment_text"])
X_test_combined = hstack([X_test_word, X_test_char])

# Train model using LinearSVC with OneVsRestClassifier
model = OneVsRestClassifier(
    LinearSVC(C=1.0, max_iter=2000, class_weight="balanced", dual=True), n_jobs=-1
)

model.fit(X_train_combined, y_train)

# Make predictions on validation set
val_preds = model.predict_proba(X_val_combined)

# Calculate mean column-wise ROC AUC
auc_scores = []
for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
    auc = roc_auc_score(y_val[col].values, val_preds[:, i])
    auc_scores.append(auc)

mean_auc = np.mean(auc_scores)
print(f"Validation Mean Column-wise ROC AUC: {mean_auc:.4f}")

# Make predictions on test set
test_preds = model.predict_proba(X_test_combined)

# Create submission dataframe
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_df["id"],
        "toxic": test_preds[:, 0],
        "severe_toxic": test_preds[:, 1],
        "obscene": test_preds[:, 2],
        "threat": test_preds[:, 3],
        "insult": test_preds[:, 4],
        "identity_hate": test_preds[:, 5],
    }
)

# Save submission
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
